name: Sasaki Yuka
source:
A university student who lives alone. She has excellent looks and figure but she herself doesn't seem to be aware of them.

Even with the destroyed city, she continues to endure and smile gently. She doesn't mind the labor of making good food to warm up everyone's morale. She's always worried about her close friend, Hibari.
